status: Interactive design proposal; awaits review; not production implementation
workflow: Approved #249 isolated interactive HTML mock and real Chrome capture; web-design-guidelines skill read and current guideline source fetched
api: ops.crossplane.io/v1alpha1; CronOperation, WatchOperation, Operation are all cluster-scoped
prerequisites: Controller execution permissions; schema presence is not readiness
owner: Optional Crossplane add-on form provider registered by GVK/version, not hardcoded into Kubernetes plugin. Generic source fallback when provider absent or schema unsupported.

mapping.boundary: required; immutable in edit; cluster-scoped so never write metadata.namespace
five-field local shape check only; server/controller parser authoritative; no inferred timezone or next-run guarantee
optional exact int64 string serialized without JS Number conversion
Allow/Forbid/Replace; unset omitted; API default Allow. Replace may replace an active run; review must warn before production mutation
optional int32; unset omitted; API defaults 3 and 1; counts are not fake execution history
both required and immutable on edit by CRD CEL self == oldSelf
omitted means all namespaces for namespaced kinds; not editor destination namespace
empty selector matches all resources of selected kind; prototype demonstrates one key; additional keys remain source-only
1–99 steps, unique step names; synthetic function-reference picker; never create a Function implicitly
optional exact int64; no automatic rerun action
arbitrary embedded Kubernetes resource with apiVersion and kind; unknown fields preserved only in raw-source fallback, no schema-specific function input editor claimed
source None or Secret; Secret reference requires name and namespace; no secret values fetched or pictured
requirementName, apiVersion, kind required; exactly one of name or matchLabels per CRD CEL; requirements and reference namespace are not destination namespace
template metadata distinct from parent; annotations absent from public fixtures
read-only; fixture outcome clearly synthetic; unavailable source not reconstructed; edit template for future controller-owned runs
read-only fixture connection, not replacement logs/dashboard; absent status stays not loaded

reuse: Dialog, SegmentedControl, FormField, Input, Select, Button, Table, Collapsible, Tooltip/Popover and existing CodeEditor in production
Faithful HTML/CSS composition only; no React/base-ui component is claimed shipped
No new generic base-ui primitive needed; operation scheduling and ownership rules stay in add-on adapter
review: Destination and intent stay visible. Reviews never send requests. Parent template changes affect future runs, not existing generated Operations. Standalone Operation deliberately executes functions; generated/completed executions inspect-first with no arbitrary status edit, retry or delete action.
sourceSafety: Form generates a bounded manifest subset. Any manual YAML edit preserves exact raw text, comments, scalar spelling, omission and unknown content, and locks Form plus review. No bidirectional parser or lossless AST patching is claimed. Credentials and annotations are absent from fixtures. Source is never persisted.
visualReview: All 30 screenshots visually inspected, including four contact sheets and individually inspected changed/help/completed/Watch-generated/source-unavailable captures. Compact 1000x700 frame, 32px controls, 13px text; main scroll, fixed footer. 720x760 narrow check shows no page overflow and visible footer.
limits: Prototype not production React, Monaco or cluster integration
